title: Stable Diffusion – much faster!
reading: The slide introduces Stable Diffusion, a latent diffusion model that runs the diffusion process in a compressed latent space rather than directly on pixels, giving large speed gains. It is described as the first large-scale, open-sourced text-to-image generative model, citing Rombach et al., CVPR 2022. Accompanying figure labels ('Image to latent', 'Diffusion model in the latent space') indicate a pipeline diagram of the encoder step followed by latent-space diffusion.

visuals.description: Pipeline diagram fragment labelled 'Image to latent' and 'Diffusion model in the latent space'.
visuals.assertion: An encoder maps images into a lower-dimensional latent space where the diffusion process is carried out.

concepts.name: Latent diffusion
concepts.why_it_matters: Operating in latent space cuts compute cost versus pixel-space diffusion.

verbatim_spans: Apply the diffusion model in the latent space instead of pixel space
The first large-scale, open-sourced text-to-image generative model
Rombach et al., High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models, CVPR 2022
